item.title: 0.1.0-alpha.4
item.description:
## Two new sound engines
Resonance now plays through libsidplayfp, the emulator behind most SID players, rendered straight into the audio output.
- **reSIDfp** is the most accurate SID emulation available and is now the default. Tunes with filter sweeps and digi samples in particular sound closer to the real chip. - **SIDLite direct** is the same compact chip model as SIDLite, on the new player. It is the lightest on the processor of the four. - **SIDLite** and **reSID** are still there. Settings → Playback lists all four with a line on what sets each apart; changing the engine restarts the tune. - Widen mono tunes doesn't apply to the two new engines yet.
## Better Sounds Like
Sounds Like finds closer matches. In testing on composers it hadn't been tuned on, nearly twice as many of its suggestions came from the same composer as the tune you're playing.
- It now looks at how each instrument is shaped, not only which waveforms and effects a tune uses. - It also compares how tunes actually sound, using a small download made in advance. Nothing is analysed on your Mac beyond the usual scan. - Percentages in Sounds Like are worked out differently, so they won't match what you saw before. - Your fingerprints are rebuilt once: Resonance downloads the new set the first time you open it.
## Fixes
- Opening a tune from a nested composer folder, such as from Sounds Like, no longer shows an empty page with 0 tunes. It opens the folder the tune is listed under.

item.title: 0.1.0-alpha.3
item.description:
## Share a tune
Send a friend the tune you're listening to.
- **Share…** next to Add to… in Now Playing, the inspector and the menu bar player, and **Share** in a tune's right-click menu, makes a short link to any tune in HVSC: Copy Link, Messages, Mail, or any other app. - Pasted into Messages, Slack, Discord and the like, the link shows the tune's card: title, composer, year, length and its sound fingerprint. - A click on **Open in Resonance** opens the tune in Resonance, at the same subtune. If your collection is older and doesn't have it, Resonance offers the HVSC update; if you have no collection yet, the download. - Friends without Resonance get a page with the tune's card, its fingerprint turning, and a download link.

item.title: 0.1.0-alpha.2
item.description:
## Automatic updates
Resonance now keeps itself up to date.
- **Check for Updates…** in the Resonance menu looks for a new version right away. - Resonance checks once a day by itself. Turn this off, or let it download and install updates when you quit, in Settings → Advanced → Updates. - Every update is checked against Resonance's signing key before it's installed. Nothing about your Mac is sent.
This is the last version you need to download by hand.
